# How to Setup Accounts

Accounts (AR) Module — Setup Guide

NOTE: Please setup a Invoice Template first

Go to Settings and click on "Accounts"

Make Accounts Active

1. Add in your prefix required on your Invoices - ie INV-

2. Select an Invoice Template - This can be created in "PDF Designer"

3. Set a Statement Schedule. Once this is set you can set for statements on each Company to be automatically sent. The default for each Company is OFF

4. Add in your email settings for sending statements. You should add in at least a From email and address. If you want a copy of the sent email add the required address  in the bcc field

5. you can optionally change the default subject and body of the email

6. Save Settings

NOTE: We recommend running test statements 

7. You will now be able to access the accounts Menu in the Dashboard Menu
